name: Marine & Freshwater Biology
summary: Life in the oceans, lakes and rivers: plankton, coral reefs, the deep sea, fisheries and the physical conditions that shape aquatic life.

topics.name: The ocean environment: light, pressure, temperature, salinity and currents
Plankton: phytoplankton, zooplankton and the microbial loop
Biological oceanography: primary production and the biological carbon pump
Intertidal and coastal ecosystems: estuaries, mangroves, seagrass
Open ocean and deep-sea biology, including hydrothermal vent communities
Marine vertebrates: fishes, marine mammals, seabirds
Ocean acidification, warming and marine conservation
